Item 39 should have read ‘N/A’
Item 35 should have read ‘N/A’ as dirty ballast would have to be pumped to the slop tank, not into the sea
Items 35 and 39 should have read ‘N/A’ as dirty ballast would have to be pumped to reception facilities ashore
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: The oily residues were transferred to the slop tank after the clean water was discharged to the sea

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: After which one of the following would you need to make a Code N entry in the oil record book part II?
options: An oil sheen is seen on the sea while discharging segregated ballast overboard
An oil sheen is seen on the sea while discharging engine room bilges overboard
The engineer doing the annual ODME service reports that it requires a new sampling pump
Oil is found on the surface of ballast water in a segregated ballast tank
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: An oil sheen is seen on the sea while discharging segregated ballast overboard

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: You have just finished Crude Oil Washing the forward half of No 2 Centre while discharging at the SupaOil berth in Singapore.^M^MWhich of the following is the correct operation code?
options: Code D
Code G
Code C
Code J
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Code D

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Your ship has discharged water from the slop tank into the sea. Which of the following best describes why there are 2 items for recording discharge flow rates in the oil record book for this one operation?
options: It is expected that the discharge rate will be slowed as the oil interface reaches the outlet pipe
It is expected that the discharge rate will be faster as the oil interface reaches the outlet pipe
One is the maximum discharge rate and the other the average flow rate
Only one of the items is recorded, depending on whether bulk flow is used or not
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: It is expected that the discharge rate will be slowed as the oil interface reaches the outlet pipe

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: A small ‘product tanker’ and a ‘tanker engaged in specific trades’ are both discharging dirty ballast from their cargo oil tanks to a reception facility ashore. Which one of the following statements about their oil record book entries is true?
options: The tanker engaged in specific trades must have the entry signed by a shore official
Both ships must record the operation under code H
The tanker engaged in specific trades must record the operation under code L
The product tanker must record whether the ODME was used during the discharge
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: The tanker engaged in specific trades must have the entry signed by a shore official

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which one of the following best describes what you should do if your old oil record book is full and the only available new one is found to contain out of date MARPOL operation codes?
options: Use the new book after replacing the out of date codes with a copy of the current ones
Use the new book and use the out of date codes for entries in it
Do not make any oil record book entries until an up to date book has been sent
Make oil record book entries in the bridge log book until an up to date book has been sent
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Use the new book after replacing the out of date codes with a copy of the current ones

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which one of the following describes the best way to find out which tanks have been designated as slop tanks on your ship, as far as oil record book entries are concerned?
options: Check the IOPP certificate
Check the capacity plan
Check the tank plan
Check the cargo oil system drawings
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Check the IOPP certificate

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which of the following statements about a Clean Ballast Tank (CBT) tanker is true?
options: The Clean Ballast Tanks remain connected to the cargo oil system
Oil is sometimes carried in Clean Ballast Tanks
Clean Ballast Tanks are completely segregated from the cargo oil system
Clean Ballast Tanks are only found on ships built since 2001
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: The Clean Ballast Tanks remain connected to the cargo oil system

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Your ship’s oil cargo tanks have been cleaned by washing with seawater and a chemical cleaning additive before drydock. Which of the following best describes how the use of chemical additives should be recorded in the oil record book?
options: It should be recorded as part of the method of cleaning (item 30)
It is not recorded
It should be recorded as a separate Code O operation
It should be recorded as part of the remarks (item 17)
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: It should be recorded as part of the method of cleaning (item 30)

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: After Crude Oil Washing a cargo tank how is the washing time recorded in the oil record book?
options: The start and stop times are recorded as separate items
The start and stop times are recorded as a single item
The start time and washing time are recorded
Only the washing time is recorded
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: The start and stop times are recorded as separate items

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which one of the following best describes how the ship’s positions in oil record book part II entries can easily be found to be false, even after some time has passed?
options: The positions in the oil record book part II do not match those in the bridge log book
The positions of ships are now tracked by satellite
The position of the ship is recorded in the bilge water separator control system and can be downloaded later
The positions are written with East/West co-ordinates before North/South ones
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: The positions in the oil record book part II do not match those in the bridge log book

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which one of the following is the maximum fine that could be imposed in Germany for an incorrect entry in the ship’s oil record book according to this program?
options: 25,000 Euros
5,000 Euros
2,000 Euros
200 Euros
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: 25,000 Euros

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which one of the following describes the best way of making sure that the quantity of slops discharged to reception facilities matches the reduction in slops retained on board?
options: Check the quantity of slops on board immediately before and after discharge ashore and make sure the reception facility receipt matches the change
Check the quantity of slops on board at the next weekly soundings and make sure the reception facility receipt matches the change
Make sure you get a detailed receipt for the slops from the reception facility
Check the levels in the cargo tanks next to the slop tank have not changed during the discharge of slops
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Check the quantity of slops on board immediately before and after discharge ashore and make sure the reception facility receipt matches the change

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which of the following best explains why the washing line pressure is recorded in the oil record book after Crude Oil Washing (COW) a cargo tank?
options: To show that the COW manual requirements were met
To show that the correct number of cleaning machines were used
To show that the cargo pump is working properly
To show that the washing line did not leak
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: To show that the COW manual requirements were met

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: The flow rate sensor on the ODME has failed. Which of the following is the correct operation code for recording this?
options: Code M
Code N
Code O
Code J
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Code M

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: You have just finished Crude Oil Washing the forward half of No 2 Centre while discharging at the SupaOil berth in Singapore. Based upon the recommendations in this training program which of the following is the correct way to start this entry in the oil record book?
options: D	  9	          SupaOil terminal Singapore^M	  10	          2C Forward section
D	  9	          1º 14’N, 103º 55’E^M	  10,11	   3 forward machines
D	  9	          SupaOil terminal Singapore^M	  10,11	   3 forward machines
D	  9	          1º 14’N, 103º 55’E^M	  10	          2C Forward section
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: D	  9	          SupaOil terminal Singapore^M	  10	          2C Forward section

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which one of the following is the maximum penalty that could be imposed in the United States for a deliberately false entry in the ship’s oil record book according to this program?
options: $250,000 and 5 years in jail for each violation
1 year in jail
$50,000 and 1 year in jail for each violation
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: $250,000 and 5 years in jail for each violation

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which one of the following is recommended as the first thing to do when starting a new oil record book?
options: Check that it contains the current operation codes
Check that it has a blue cover
Check that it has a green cover
Write the ship’s name on it
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Check that it contains the current operation codes

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which of the following best describes what should be recorded in the oil record book after Crude Oil Washing (COW) a cargo tank as item 17?
options: An explanation of why COW manual requirements were not met
Item 17 is not related to COW
Remarks on how well the COW went
Remarks on why COW was not carried out
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: An explanation of why COW manual requirements were not met

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which one of the following operation codes would be the best to use to record the fact that the overboard discharge valve from the slop tank has been sealed while the ship passes through the Mediterranean MARPOL Special Area?
options: Code O
Code I
Code J
Code M
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Code O

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: A Port State Control Officer finds a mistake in the oil record book dated last week, when the ship was in the middle of the Pacific. Can you or the ship be fined for the mistake?
options: Yes
No
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Yes

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: If an entry in an oil record book looks incorrect or improbable, what would the authorities conclude?
options: That an illegal discharge may have been made and that this an attempt to cover it up
That an honest mistake has been made
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: That an illegal discharge may have been made and that this an attempt to cover it up

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: You are on a tanker ‘engaged on a specific trade’ which is discharging ballast. ^M^MWhich of the following is the correct operation code for recording this?
options: Code R
Code P
Code H
Code L
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Code R

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: A PSCO asks why an oil record book entry for Crude Oil Washing (COW) has no entry for item 17. The officer who made the entry is no longer onboard. Which of the following is the best way to avoid these questions?
options: Enter ‘not applicable’ (N/A) as item 17 every time that the COW manual requirements were met
Say the officer in charge forgot and make a late entry under Code O
Do not show the PSCO the oil record book
Tear out that page of the oil record book
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Enter ‘not applicable’ (N/A) as item 17 every time that the COW manual requirements were met

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: You have just finished transferring 30m³ of oil from No 3 Port to No 3 Stbd.^M^MWhich of the following is the correct operation code?
options: Code B
Code A
Code I
Code J
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Code B

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: It is the last day of September and you are going to make an entry in the oil record book. Which one of the following is the correct date format?
The oil record book entry relates to the loading of a cargo of 350 m³ of diesel oil. Which one of the following is the correct operation code to enter?
options: Code A
Code C
Code N
Code P
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Code A

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: You find that the deck cadet has made an entry in the oil record book using a pencil. Which one of the following best describes what you, as senior officer on watch, should do about this?
options: You erase the pencil entry and replace it with an entry using pen, explaining to the cadet why this is required
You sign for the entry in pen and tell the cadet he is not allowed to write in the book
You get the cadet to sign for the entry
Ignore the incomplete entry in pencil and write the proper entry in pen underneath it
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: You erase the pencil entry and replace it with an entry using pen, explaining to the cadet why this is required

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which one of the following best describes which ships are required to maintain an oil record book part II according to the MARPOL Convention?
options: Oil tankers over 150 gross tonnage and other ships which carry more than 200 m³ of bulk oil as cargo
All ships over 400 gross tonnage
All ships on international voyages
All ships over 150 gross tonnage
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Oil tankers over 150 gross tonnage and other ships which carry more than 200 m³ of bulk oil as cargo

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which one of the following best describes what should be done with an oil record book when it is full?
options: Enter the end date and get the master to sign the last page before storing it for the next 3 years
Just start a new book
Enter the end date and get the master to sign the last page before sending it back to the company for inspection
Show it to the master before throwing it away
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Enter the end date and get the master to sign the last page before storing it for the next 3 years

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: When starting a new oil record book you notice that the slop tank capacity on the IOPP certificate does not match that in the slop tank sounding tables, which you believe to be accurate.^M^MWhich one of the following best describes what you should do about this?
options: Ask the master to get the IOPP certificate corrected
Ignore it as the ship is already 7 years old
Hide the slop tank sounding tables in a drawer
Assume that the slop tank capacity has been downgraded
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Ask the master to get the IOPP certificate corrected

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which of the following best describes what PSCOs are likely to think if they find an oil record book containing many corrected entries?
options: The crew have a casual attitude to MARPOL compliance
The chief officer demands accuracy
The voyage plans for the ship frequently change
The cargo control room pen does not write well
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: The crew have a casual attitude to MARPOL compliance

CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.question: Which of the following best describes what reason a PSCO might accept to explain why the slop tank contains less today than was recorded in the oil record book yesterday?
options: Yesterday's sounding was taken during bad weather
Some water has evaporated overnight
The mooring ropes have caused a list
The tank has a leak
CD0219 — Oil Record Book, Part II.answer: Yesterday's sounding was taken during bad weather

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Which of the following is a hazard that may be encountered when opening the door of a hot oven?
options: Heat blast.
Electrical failure.
Boil-over of pans within the oven.
Overheating in the galley.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Heat blast.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Что из нижеперечисленного является риском, с которым можно столкнуться при открывании створки горячего духового шкафа?
options: Выброс горячего пара.
Повреждение электрической цепи.
Переливание кипящей жидкости из посуды внутри духового шкафа.
Чрезмерно высокая температура на камбузе.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Выброс горячего пара.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 打开高温烤箱时可能会遇到以下哪种危险？
options: 热浪。
电气故障。
烤箱内锅具沸腾。
厨房过热。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 热浪。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: A quale rischio, tra quelli seguenti, si può essere soggetti nell'aprire lo sportello di un forno caldo?
options: Un'ondata di calore.
Un'avaria elettrica.
Il traboccamento delle casseruole o teglie all'interno del forno.
Il surriscaldamento della cambusa.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Un'ondata di calore.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Parmi les dangers suivants, lequel peut survenir à l'ouverture de la porte d'un four chaud ?
options: Souffle de chaleur
Panne d'électricité
Débordement de casseroles dans le four
Surchauffe dans la cuisine
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Souffle de chaleur

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: When working with power-driven food processing equipment in a galley, such as a mixer, how should you be dressed?
options: In a manner such that my sleeves, apron, hair or jewellery cannot get caught in the machine.
I should wear goggles, rubber gloves and a protective jacket.
I do not need to take any special precautions with regard to my clothing.
It doesn’t matter too much, provided I have control of the machine at all times.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: In a manner such that my sleeves, apron, hair or jewellery cannot get caught in the machine.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Как вы должны быть одеты при работе на камбузе с таким механическим оборудованием для приготовления пищи, как миксер?
options: Я должен быть одет таким образом, чтобы мои рукава, фартук, волосы или украшения не могли быть захвачены машиной.
На мне должны быть очки, резиновые перчатки и защитная куртка.
Я не должен принимать никаких специальных мер предосторожности, касающихся моей одежды.
Это не имеет большого значения, если я постоянно контролирую работу машины.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Я должен быть одет таким образом, чтобы мои рукава, фартук, волосы или украшения не могли быть захвачены машиной.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 在厨房内使用电动食品加工设备，如搅拌机时，应该采用什么样的穿衣方式？
options: 没有会卡在机器内的袖子、围裙、头发或珠宝之类的东西。
应该带护目镜、橡胶手套和防护服。
对于衣物不需要采取任何特别的预防措施。
没有太大关系，因为我随时可以控制机器。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 没有会卡在机器内的袖子、围裙、头发或珠宝之类的东西。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: In che modo bisogna vestirsi per lavorare nella cambusa con apparecchi elettrici per la lavorazione dei cibi, come un'impastatrice?
options: In modo da impedire che maniche, grembiuli, capelli e accessori come ciondoli, braccialetti ecc. rimangano impigliati nella macchina.
Occorre indossare occhiali protettivi, guanti di gomma e giacchetta da lavoro.
Non occorre prendere particolari precauzioni riguardo all'abbigliamento.
Non ha molta importanza, purché si mantenga sempre il controllo della macchina.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: In modo da impedire che maniche, grembiuli, capelli e accessori come ciondoli, braccialetti ecc. rimangano impigliati nella macchina.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Lorsque vous manipulez un équipement électrique de transformation des aliments en cuisine, comme un mixeur, quelle tenue devez-vous porter ?
options: Je dois veiller à ce que mon tablier, mes manches, mes cheveux et mes bijoux ne restent pas coincés dans la machine
Je dois porter des lunettes de protection, des gants en caoutchouc et une veste de protection
Je ne dois pas prendre de précautions particulières en ce qui concerne mes vêtements
Ça n'a pas vraiment d'importance, tant que je garde le contrôle des machines à chaque instant
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Je dois veiller à ce que mon tablier, mes manches, mes cheveux et mes bijoux ne restent pas coincés dans la machine

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Who can carry out repairs on electrical equipment in the galley?
options: Such repairs should only be carried out by competent engineers.
Anyone.
Defective galley electrical equipment can only be repaired by an appointed service agent ashore.
No one should attempt repairs; once such equipment is defective, it should be replaced.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Such repairs should only be carried out by competent engineers.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Кто может выполнять работы по ремонту электрооборудования на камбузе?
options: Такие ремонтные работы могут выполняться только квалифицированными специалистами.
Кто угодно.
Неисправное кухонное электрооборудование может быть отремонтировано только назначенным сотрудником сервисной службы на берегу.
Никто не должен предпринимать попытки отремонтировать неисправное оборудование. Такое оборудование следует заменить новым.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Такие ремонтные работы могут выполняться только квалифицированными специалистами.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 哪些人可以对厨房内的电气设备进行维修？
options: 此类维修只应由具备资格的管轮完成。
任何人。
有缺陷的厨房电气设备只能由岸上指定的维修机构进行维修。
任何人均不应进行维修； 一旦此类设备出现问题，则应该更换。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 此类维修只应由具备资格的管轮完成。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Chi può riparare gli apparecchi elettrici della cambusa?
options: Le riparazioni devono essere effettuate esclusivamente da tecnici qualificati.
Chiunque.
Gli apparecchi della cambusa guasti possono essere riparati solo da un tecnico dell'assistenza sulla terraferma.
Nessuno deve tentare di effettuare riparazioni; se un apparecchio presenta dei malfunzionamenti, deve essere sostituito.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Le riparazioni devono essere effettuate esclusivamente da tecnici qualificati.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Quelle est la personne autorisée à effectuer des réparations sur les équipements électriques en cuisine ?
options: Les réparations ne peuvent être effectuées que par des mécaniciens compétents
Tout le monde peut effectuer les réparations
Les équipements électriques défectueux peuvent uniquement être réparés par l'agent de service désigné à terre
Personne ne doit entreprendre des réparations : dès qu'un équipement de ce type est défectueux, il doit être remplacé
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Les réparations ne peuvent être effectuées que par des mécaniciens compétents

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: After cleaning, servicing and re-assembling a food processing machine, what should be done before it is used again for food?
options: It should be tested.
A report should be sent to the manufacturer.
The Ship Safety Officer should run it.
It should be run using just fresh water first.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: It should be tested.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: После того как кухонное оборудование для приготовления пищи вымыто, обработано и собрано, что необходимо сделать перед его следующим использованием?
options: Необходимо проверить его работоспособность.
Необходимо отправить отчет производителю.
Специалист по технике безопасности судна должен включить оборудование и запустить рабочий цикл.
Необходимо включить оборудование и запустить первый рабочий цикл с использованием только питьевой воды.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Необходимо проверить его работоспособность.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 清洁、保养并重新组装一台食品加工机器之后，再次用于加工食品之前应该怎么做？
options: 应该进行测试。
应该向制造商发送报告。
船只安全官应该运行。
应该首先使用新鲜水运行。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 应该进行测试。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Dopo aver pulito, manutenuto e rimontato una macchina per la lavorazione del cibo, cosa occorre fare per poterla utilizzare nuovamente per gli alimenti?
options: Bisogna testarla.
Occorre inviare un rapporto al fabbricante.
Deve essere fatta funzionare dal responsabile della sicurezza della nave.
La prima volta deve essere fatta funzionare solo con acqua pulita.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Bisogna testarla.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Que faut-il faire avant de pouvoir réutiliser une machine de transformation des aliments qui vient d'être nettoyée, entretenue et remontée ?
options: Il faut la tester
Il faut envoyer un rapport au fabricant
Il faut que le responsable de sécurité du navire la mette en marche
Il faut d'abord lancer un cycle avec de l'eau fraîche uniquement
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Il faut la tester

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: What is the main precaution that should be taken with electrical equipment, prior to washing down the galley?
options: All power to the galley range and other electrical equipment should be switched off and isolated before washing down.
The units should be switched on to ensure that they dry off in the shortest possible time.
Electrical equipment should be removed, or covered in plastic sheeting.
No washing down should be carried out in areas containing electrical equipment.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: All power to the galley range and other electrical equipment should be switched off and isolated before washing down.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Какие основные меры предосторожности необходимо принять в отношении электрооборудования до начала влажной уборки на камбузе?
options: Перед влажной уборкой все плиты и другое электрооборудование на камбузе должны быть выключены и отсоединены от источника питания.
Оборудование необходимо включить, чтобы оно могло высохнуть в кратчайшие сроки.
Электрооборудование необходимо убрать или накрыть полимерной пленкой.
На участках с электрооборудованием влажная уборка не проводится.

The galley is an area which may be locked and therefore not included in the night-watchman’s safety rounds.
The galley is an area which is continuously entered throughout a 24-hour period, while some other rooms in the accommodation are not.
The galley is an area fitted with extra fire detection equipment.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: The galley contains equipment capable of providing the source of ignition in a fire yet is left unattended for most of the night.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Что из нижеперечисленного является ключевым показателем, который отличает камбуз от других жилых помещений на обычном грузовом судне?
options: На камбузе размещено оборудование, которое может стать источником возгорания, если его оставить на ночь без наблюдения.
Камбуз представляет собой помещение, которое запирается, поэтому может не включаться в ночные обходы вахтенного для проверки безопасности.
Камбуз представляет собой помещение, доступ к которому открыт круглосуточно, в отличие от других жилых помещений.
Камбуз представляет собой помещение, оборудованное дополнительными устройствами обнаружения пожара.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: На камбузе размещено оборудование, которое может стать источником возгорания, если его оставить на ночь без наблюдения.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 在一个普通货船上，以下哪个是厨房和舱室其他区域之间的重要区别？
options: 厨房包含了能够提供火源的设备，而且在大多数情况下夜间无人看管。
厨房是可以锁闭的区域，因此没有包括在夜间值班人员安全巡逻范围内。
厨房是 24 小时均可进入的区域，而舱室内的一些其他房间则不行。
厨房配备了附加的火情探测设备。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 厨房包含了能够提供火源的设备，而且在大多数情况下夜间无人看管。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Su una normale nave da carico, quali dei seguenti elementi rappresenta la differenza fondamentale tra la cambusa e il settore alloggi?
options: La cambusa contiene attrezzature che possono fungere da fonte di innesco di un incendio, e che tuttavia vengono lasciate incustodite per la maggior parte della notte.
La cambusa è un'area che può essere chiusa a chiave e che non rientra quindi nei giri di ispezione del guardiano notturno.
La cambusa è un'area nella quale entrano continuamente persone per ventiquattr'ore al giorno, mentre ciò non avviene nel settore alloggi.
La cambusa è un'area provvista di dispositivi supplementari di rilevamento degli incendi.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: La cambusa contiene attrezzature che possono fungere da fonte di innesco di un incendio, e che tuttavia vengono lasciate incustodite per la maggior parte della notte.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Sur un navire de charge classique, laquelle des propositions suivantes illustre la différence essentielle entre la cuisine et les autres zones du navire ?
options: La cuisine abrite des équipements présentant des risques d'incendie et souvent laissés une grande partie de la nuit sans surveillance
Comme la cuisine peut être fermée à clé, le veilleur de nuit ne l'inclut pas dans ses rondes de sécurité
La cuisine représente une zone de passage constant, à la différence d'autres espaces du navire
La cuisine est équipée d'un équipement de détection d'incendie supplémentaire
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: La cuisine abrite des équipements présentant des risques d'incendie et souvent laissés une grande partie de la nuit sans surveillance

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: (Not counting a vessel that carries special extinguishers for fires involving cooking fat and oil), which two classes of fire would the extinguishers normally found in a galley be capable of controlling?
options: Flammable liquids and electrical fires.
Flammable liquids and flammable gases.
Ordinary combustibles and flammable gases.
Electrical equipment and combustible metals.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Flammable liquids and electrical fires.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Для каких двух классов пожара предназначены огнетушители, обычно размещенные на камбузе (не считая суда, на которых имеются специальные огнетушители для пожаров, вызванных горением кулинарного жира и масла)?
options: Пожары, вызванные горением воспламеняющихся жидкостей и электрооборудования.
Пожары, вызванные горением воспламеняющихся жидкостей и газов.
Пожары, вызванные горением обычных горючих материалов и воспламеняющихся газов.
Пожары, вызванные горением электрооборудования и горючих металлов.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Пожары, вызванные горением воспламеняющихся жидкостей и электрооборудования.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: （不考虑携带油脂烹饪火灾特制灭火器的船舶），厨房内的灭火器通常要能够控制哪两种类型的火情？
options: 可燃液体和电气火情。
可燃液体和可燃气体。
一般可燃气体。
电气设备和可燃金属。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 可燃液体和电气火情。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Non considerando il caso di una nave dotata di estintori studiati appositamente per i roghi generati da grasso o olio da cucina, quali due classi di incendi sono in grado di spegnere gli estintori di norma presenti in una cambusa?
options: Liquidi infiammabili e incendi su componenti elettrici.
Liquidi infiammabili e gas infiammabili.
Combustibili comuni e gas infiammabili.
Apparecchi elettrici e metalli combustibili.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Liquidi infiammabili e incendi su componenti elettrici.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: (Sans tenir compte des navires qui transportent des extincteurs spéciaux pour combattre les incendies dus à la graisse et à l'huile de cuisson), quelles sont les deux classes d'incendies que les extincteurs généralement présents en cuisine peuvent maîtriser ?
options: Les liquides inflammables et les incendies électriques
Les liquides et les gaz inflammables
Les combustibles ordinaires et les gaz inflammables
Les équipements électriques et les métaux combustibles
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Les liquides inflammables et les incendies électriques

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: When cleaning and servicing a slicing machine, which of the following is a critical safety requirement?
options: That the machine is switched off and isolated before work starts.
There are no special or critical safety requirements.  This is a routine task.
That I am wearing rubber gloves.
That I have anti-static (natural fibre) cleaning brushes available.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: That the machine is switched off and isolated before work starts.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Какое критически важное правило безопасности следует соблюдать при очистке и обслуживании резальных машин?
options: Машина должна быть выключена и отсоединена от источника питания до начала работ.
Каких-либо специальных или критически важных правил безопасности не предусмотрено. Такие операции являются стандартными.
Необходимо надевать резиновые перчатки.
Необходимо использовать антистатические (из натурального волокна) щетки для чистки.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Машина должна быть выключена и отсоединена от источника питания до начала работ.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 清洁和维修切片机时，以下哪项是一个重要安全要求？
options: 工作开始之前，机器关闭，拔下电源。
没有特殊的或重要的安全要求。这是一项例行任务。
我要戴橡胶手套。
我有防静电（自然纤维）清洁刷。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 工作开始之前，机器关闭，拔下电源。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Nel pulire ed effettuare la manutenzione di un'affettatrice, quale dei seguenti elementi costituisce un requisito critico per la sicurezza?
options: Che la macchina venga spenta e scollegata dall'alimentazione elettrica prima di iniziare l'intervento.
Non vi sono requisiti speciali o critici per la sicurezza.  Si tratta di un'attività di routine.
Che si indossino guanti di gomma.
Avere a disposizione spazzolini per pulizia antistatici (in fibra naturale).
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Che la macchina venga spenta e scollegata dall'alimentazione elettrica prima di iniziare l'intervento.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Parmi les propositions suivantes, laquelle est essentielle pour garantir la sécurité lors du nettoyage et de l'entretien d'une trancheuse ?
options: La machine doit être éteinte et isolée de l'alimentation électrique avant le nettoyage et l'entretien
Il n'existe aucune exigence de sécurité particulière,  comme il s'agit d'une tâche de routine
L'utilisateur doit porter des gants en caoutchouc
L'utilisateur doit disposer de brosses de nettoyage antistatiques (en fibres naturelles)
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: La machine doit être éteinte et isolée de l'alimentation électrique avant le nettoyage et l'entretien

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: For an ordinary cargo ship at sea, which of the following policies would generally apply to the watchman and his safety rounds during the night?
options: The watchman should include the galley in his night-time safety rounds.
The galley should be locked shut and the watchman will not include it in his night-time safety rounds.
Provided the cook reports to the bridge that all is safe at the end of the day, there is no need to include the galley in the night-time safety rounds.
The galley is specifically excluded from a watchman’s night-time safety rounds.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: The watchman should include the galley in his night-time safety rounds.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Какая политика чаще всего применяется в отношении вахтенного и совершаемых им ночных обходов в целях проверки безопасности на обычном грузовом судне в море?
options: Вахтенный должен включить камбуз в маршрут ночных обходов, совершаемых им в целях проверки безопасности.
Камбуз должен быть заперт, и вахтенный не должен включать его в маршрут ночных обходов, совершаемых им в целях проверки безопасности.
При условии, что повар сообщает на мостик в конце рабочего дня о том, что все требования техники безопасности соблюдены, включать камбуз в маршрут ночного обхода нет необходимости.
Камбуз специально не включен в маршрут ночного обхода, совершаемого вахтенным в целях проверки безопасности.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Вахтенный должен включить камбуз в маршрут ночных обходов, совершаемых им в целях проверки безопасности.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 在一艘海上航行的普通货船上，以下哪个策略适用于值班人员以及夜间的安全巡逻？
options: 值班人员在其夜间安全巡逻中应该包括厨房。
厨房应该锁闭，夜间值班人员安全巡逻中不包括厨房。
如果厨师在一天结束时向驾驶台报告了一切安全，则没有必要在夜间安全巡逻中包括厨房。
厨房时专门排除在值班人员夜间安全巡逻之外的。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 值班人员在其夜间安全巡逻中应该包括厨房。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Per una normale nave da carico che si trovi in mare, quali delle seguenti norme si applicano in genere al guardiano e ai suoi giri di ispezione notturni?
options: Durante i suoi giri di ispezione notturni il guardiano deve controllare anche la cambusa.
La cambusa deve essere chiusa a chiave e il guardiano non la controllerà durante i suoi giri di ispezione notturni.
Purché a fine giornata il cuoco riferisca al ponte di comando che tutto è in ordine, non è necessario controllare anche la cambusa nei giri di ispezione notturni.
La cambusa è specificamente esclusa dai giri di ispezione notturni del guardiano.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Durante i suoi giri di ispezione notturni il guardiano deve controllare anche la cambusa.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Sur un navire de charge ordinaire en mer, laquelle des politiques suivantes s'applique généralement aux rondes de sécurité nocturnes du veilleur ?
options: Le veilleur doit inspecter la cuisine pendant ses rondes de sécurité nocturnes
La cuisine doit être fermée à clé et ne doit pas faire partie des rondes de sécurité nocturnes du veilleur
La cuisine ne doit pas faire partie des rondes de sécurité nocturnes du veilleur pour autant que le cuisinier ait signalé l'absence de dangers en fin de journée à la passerelle
La cuisine ne fait spécifiquement pas partie des rondes de sécurité nocturnes du veilleur
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Le veilleur doit inspecter la cuisine pendant ses rondes de sécurité nocturnes

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: What is the safest policy in respect of washing knives?
options: Be responsible for washing your own knives; never leave them in the sink.
Always leave them in the sink for the steward to wash.
Do not wash knives, only wipe them.
Leave them on a work surface; it will be obvious which ones need washing.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Be responsible for washing your own knives; never leave them in the sink.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Назовите основное правило безопасности, которое необходимо соблюдать при мытье ножей?
options: Мыть свои ножи самостоятельно и никогда не оставлять их в раковине.
Всегда оставлять ножи в раковине, с тем чтобы их вымыл стюард.
Не мыть ножи, а только протирать их.
Оставлять ножи на рабочей поверхности; тогда будет понятно, какой из них следует вымыть.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Мыть свои ножи самостоятельно и никогда не оставлять их в раковине.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 清洗刀具时最安全的策略是什么？
options: 负责清洗自己的刀具； 永远不要放在水槽内。
永远放在水槽内以便管家进行清洗。
不要清洗刀具，只擦就行。
放在工作面上； 很明显可以看出哪个需要清洗。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 负责清洗自己的刀具； 永远不要放在水槽内。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Qual è la prassi più sicura per il lavaggio dei coltelli?
options: Ognuno deve lavarsi da sé i propri coltelli; mai lasciarli nel lavello.
Lasciarli sempre nel lavello, dove il cambusiere provvederà a lavarli.
Non lavare i coltelli, pulirli e basta.
Lasciarli sulla superficie di lavoro, dove apparirà ovvio quali sono da lavare e quali no.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Ognuno deve lavarsi da sé i propri coltelli; mai lasciarli nel lavello.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Quelle est la politique la plus sûre en matière de nettoyage des couteaux ?
options: Il convient de nettoyer ses propres couteaux : il ne faut jamais les laisser dans l'évier
Il convient de toujours les laisser dans l'évier afin que l'intendant les nettoie
Il ne faut pas nettoyer les couteaux, seulement les essuyer
Il convient de les laisser sur le plan de travail pour savoir lesquels doivent être nettoyés
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Il convient de nettoyer ses propres couteaux : il ne faut jamais les laisser dans l'évier

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Why can all glassware not be cleaned in a dishwasher?
options: Because some glassware is not dishwasher proof.
Because some cleaning programmes depend on there being a mixture of glassware, crockery and cutlery in the dishwasher at the same time.
Because the racks in dishwashers are not designed to handle only glassware.
Because the salt additive is extremely abrasive on glass that is low in silicate content.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Because some glassware is not dishwasher proof.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Почему не всю стеклянную посуду можно мыть в посудомоечной машине?
options: Потому что некоторая стеклянная посуда не пригодна для мытья в посудомоечной машине.
Потому что некоторые программы рассчитаны на одновременное размещение в посудомоечной машине столовых приборов, стеклянной и глиняной посуды.
Потому что этажерки в посудомоечных машинах не рассчитаны на мытье только стеклянной посуды.
Потому что солевые добавки очень агрессивно воздействуют на стекло с низким содержанием кремнекислой соли.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Потому что некоторая стеклянная посуда не пригодна для мытья в посудомоечной машине.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 为什么并非所有玻璃器皿均可在洗碗机中清洁？
options: 因为某些玻璃器皿使用洗碗机不安全。
因为某些清洗程序取决于是否同时存在玻璃器皿、陶瓷和刀具。
因为洗碗机内的搁物架不是设计为仅处理玻璃器皿。
因为盐添加剂非常磨损硅含量较低的玻璃。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 因为某些玻璃器皿使用洗碗机不安全。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Perché non tutti gli oggetti di vetro possono essere lavati in lavastoviglie?
options: Perché alcuni di essi non sono a prova di lavastoviglie.
Perché alcuni programmi di pulizia richiedono che nella lavastoviglie siano presenti allo stesso tempo vetri, ceramiche e posate.
Perché i cestelli delle lavastoviglie non sono pensati per lavare esclusivamente oggetti di vetro.
Perché il sale per lavastoviglie è estremamente abrasivo sul vetro con basso contenuto di silicati.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Perché alcuni di essi non sono a prova di lavastoviglie.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Pourquoi ne peut-on pas placer tous les types de verrerie dans un lave-vaisselle ?
options: Parce que certains types de verrerie ne sont pas résistants au lave-vaisselle
Parce que certains programmes de nettoyage sont faits pour nettoyer un mélange de verrerie, de vaisselle et de couverts à la fois
Parce que les paniers d'un lave-vaisselle ne sont pas uniquement conçus pour accueillir de la verrerie
Parce que le sel est extrêmement abrasif pour le verre à faible teneur en silicate
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Parce que certains types de verrerie ne sont pas résistants au lave-vaisselle

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: When filling pans in a galley at sea, what must always be considered?
options: The prevailing weather conditions and movement of the ship.
The type of metal used in the pan.
The time required for cooking the food in the pan.
The amount of fresh water available.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: The prevailing weather conditions and movement of the ship.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Что всегда следует учитывать при наполнении кастрюль/сковород в условиях нахождения судна в море?
options: Преобладающие погодные условия и движение судна.
Тип металла, из которого изготовлена кастрюля/сковородка.
Время, требуемое для приготовления пищи в кастрюле/сковородке.
Количество имеющейся питьевой воды.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Преобладающие погодные условия и движение судна.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 在海上厨房向国内装水时，务必要考虑什么？
options: 天气情况和船只的移动。
锅具中使用的金属类型。
在锅中烹饪食物所需的时间。
可用淡水的量。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 天气情况和船只的移动。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Quando nella cambusa, mentre si è in mare aperto, si riempie una pentola o una padella, di cosa occorre sempre tenere conto?
options: Delle condizioni meteorologiche e del movimento della nave.
Del tipo di metallo utilizzato per la padella.
Del tempo necessario per cuocere il cibo nella padella.
Della quantità di acqua fresca disponibile.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Delle condizioni meteorologiche e del movimento della nave.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: De quoi faut-il toujours tenir compte au moment de remplir des casseroles lorsque le navire se trouve en mer ?
options: Des conditions météorologiques et du mouvement du bateau
Du type de métal dont se compose la casserole
De la durée requise pour la cuisson
De la quantité d'eau fraîche disponible
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Des conditions météorologiques et du mouvement du bateau

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Which of the following is most likely to have an Equipment Operating Notice next to it?
options: A meat slicing machine.
A coffee maker.
A rice cooker.
A ready-use refrigerator.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: A meat slicing machine.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Рядом с каким оборудованием скорее всего будет размещено указание по его эксплуатации?
options: Машина для резки мяса.
Кофемашина.
Рисоварка.
Стандартный холодильник.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Машина для резки мяса.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 以下哪项最可能在旁边有一个设备运行通知？
options: 肉类切片机。
咖啡机。
蒸饭机。
准备使用的冰箱。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 肉类切片机。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Quale dei seguenti apparecchi è più probabile che abbia, accanto a sé, un avviso di attrezzatura in funzione?
options: Un'affettatrice per la carne.
Una macchina per il caffè.
Un cuociriso.
Un frigorifero pronto uso.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Un'affettatrice per la carne.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Sur lequel des appareils suivants est-il le plus probable de trouver un panneau d'équipement sous tension ?
options: Une trancheuse

To stop them going rusty.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: To prevent contamination that might occur if they are left around close to food or food waste.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Перевязочные иглы после использования и очистки следует хранить в подписанной коробке. Помимо предотвращения травм, для чего еще это делается?
options: Для предотвращения загрязнения, которое может произойти, если оставить иглы рядом с продуктами или их отходами.
Для выполнения предписаний Управления по санитарному надзору за качеством пищевых продуктов и медикаментов (США).
Для того чтобы случайно не перепутать их со швейными иглами.
Для того чтобы иглы не покрылись ржавчиной.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Для предотвращения загрязнения, которое может произойти, если оставить иглы рядом с продуктами или их отходами.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 捆扎针在用完并清洁之后，应该放在一个带标签的盒子里。这样可以防止受伤，另一个用途是什么？
options: 防止放在食物或食物垃圾周围可能发生的污染。
为了遵循美国食品药品局导则。
防止被误认为帆布缝纫针。
防止其生锈。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 防止放在食物或食物垃圾周围可能发生的污染。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Dopo ogni utilizzo, gli aghi per pollame devono essere puliti e riposti in una scatola provvista di etichetta.  Ciò serve a prevenire gli infortuni e per quale altro scopo?
options: Prevenire possibili contaminazioni qualora vengano lasciati vicino al cibo o a residui alimentari.
Ottemperare alle linee guida della statunitense Food and Drug Administration.
Evitare che vengano scambiati per aghi da cucito.
Per impedire che arrugginiscano.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Prevenire possibili contaminazioni qualora vengano lasciati vicino al cibo o a residui alimentari.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Les aiguilles à brider doivent être rangées dans une boîte étiquetée et nettoyées après utilisation,  non seulement pour éviter les blessures, mais également pour... ?
options: Empêcher toute contamination liée au contact d'aliments ou de déchets alimentaires
Respecter les instructions de la Food and Drug Administration des États-Unis
Éviter toute confusion avec des aiguilles à coudre
Empêcher la formation de rouille
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Empêcher toute contamination liée au contact d'aliments ou de déchets alimentaires

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: What is a fire blanket used for?
options: To smother a liquid fires in a pan, such as burning cooking oil.
To wrap around a casualty who has been burned.
To hang around an area in which an open flame is burning, such as from a barbeque grill, to safely isolate it from other food preparation areas.
To protect a cook from a dish that is “spitting” hot oil, by wrapping it around his upper body.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: To smother a liquid fires in a pan, such as burning cooking oil.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Для чего используется противопожарное полотно?
options: Для тушения возгорания жидкости (например, горящего кулинарного жира) в кастрюле/сковородке.
Для оборачивания им пострадавшего, получившего ожоги.
Для ограждения им участка горения открытым пламенем, например гриль-барбекю, с целью изолирования его от других участков приготовления пищи.
Для оборачивания им верхней части тела повара в целях его защиты от брызг горячего масла при приготовлении пищи.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Для тушения возгорания жидкости (например, горящего кулинарного жира) в кастрюле/сковородке.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 灭火毯是做什么用的？
options: 为了盖住平底锅内的液体火情，如燃烧的烹饪油。
为了裹住已经燃烧的受害者。
为了在有开放性火焰的区域来回走动，如烧烤架，以便将其安全与其他食物制备区域隔离开来。
为了让厨师包裹住自己的上身，保护其避开喷溅的热油。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 为了盖住平底锅内的液体火情，如燃烧的烹饪油。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: A cosa serve una coperta ignifuga?
options: A spegnere l'incendio di un liquido in una padella (ad esempio, olio da cucina in fiamme).
Ad avvolgere un ustionato.
A isolare una zona in cui sono presenti fiamme libere (come una griglia per il barbecue) dalle altre aree preposte alla preparazione dei cibi.
A proteggere un cuoco da un piatto da cui spruzza olio bollente.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: A spegnere l'incendio di un liquido in una padella (ad esempio, olio da cucina in fiamme).

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: À quoi servent les couvertures anti-feu ?
options: À empêcher qu'un liquide, comme une huile de cuisson, ne prenne feu dans une casserole (par étouffement)
À être enroulées autour d'une victime souffrant de brûlure
À être accrochées dans une zone caractérisée par des flammes nues, comme une grille de barbecue, afin de l'isoler de manière sécurisée des autres zones dans lesquelles de la nourriture est préparée
À protéger les cuisiniers de l'huile chaude qui les « éclabousse », si elles sont enroulées autour du haut du corps
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: À empêcher qu'un liquide, comme une huile de cuisson, ne prenne feu dans une casserole (par étouffement)

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: How should you pick up a knife from a bench?
options: By the handle, with the point of the blade facing away from you.
By the handle, with the point of the blade facing towards you.
By sliding it to the edge of the workbench and picking it up by whichever part is overhanging the edge.
It doesn’t matter really and depends how it was left by the last person who used it.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: By the handle, with the point of the blade facing away from you.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Как следует брать нож с рабочей поверхности?
options: За рукоятку, острием лезвия в направлении «от себя».
За рукоятку, острием лезвия в направлении «к себе».
Подвинуть нож к краю рабочей поверхности и взять его за любую часть, которая нависает над краем.
Это не имеет значения и зависит от того, в каком положении нож оставил человек, который пользовался им последний раз.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: За рукоятку, острием лезвия в направлении «от себя».

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 应该如何拿起工作台上的刀具？
options: 用刀把，刀尖远离自己。
用刀把，刀尖指向自己。
将其滑到工作台的边缘，然后拿起露出边缘的任何部位。
基本没什么影响，取决于上一个使用的人是怎么放的。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 用刀把，刀尖远离自己。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Come si prende un coltello da un tavolo da lavoro?
options: Per il manico, con la punta della lama rivolta verso l'esterno.
Per il manico, con la punta della lama rivolta verso di sé.
Spostandolo fin sul bordo del tavolo e quindi prendendolo per qualunque parte sporga oltre il bordo.
In realtà non ha molta importanza; dipende dalla posizione in cui è stato lasciato sul tavolo dall'ultima persona che l'ha utilizzato.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Per il manico, con la punta della lama rivolta verso l'esterno.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Comment devez-vous saisir un couteau posé sur le plan de travail ?
options: Par la poignée, la pointe de la lame vers le plan de travail
Par la poignée, la pointe de la lame vers vous
En le faisant glisser le long du plan de travail et en le saisissant par n'importe quel côté
Cela n'a pas vraiment d'importance et dépend surtout de la position dans laquelle il a été laissé par la dernière personne à l'avoir utilisé
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Par la poignée, la pointe de la lame vers le plan de travail

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: A walk-in refrigerator has been out of service for an extended period of time and needs cleaning.  When standing near the open door, people feel a little dizzy and there is a suspicion that there may be a leak from the cooling system, requiring a repair.  What are you going to do?
options: Notify the ship’s Safety Officer, who will perform a Risk Assessment and advise on the safety precautions necessary.
Nothing special, it’s only a refrigerator and everything will be OK.
Go inside and check but ensure that you get someone else to go inside the space with you.
Hold your breath as you enter, locate the gas leak and stick some tape over the hole.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Notify the ship’s Safety Officer, who will perform a Risk Assessment and advise on the safety precautions necessary.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Холодильная камера длительное время не использовалась, поэтому ее необходимо привести в порядок.  Люди, стоящие рядом с открытой дверью, начинают испытывать головокружение. Предположительно произошла разгерметизация системы охлаждения, что требует проведения ремонтных работ. Как вы думаете, какие шаги необходимо предпринять?
options: Проинформировать специалиста по технике безопасности судна, который проведет оценку рисков и даст указания относительно необходимых мер предосторожности.
Ничего особенного. Это всего лишь холодильник, и все будет в порядке.
Войти внутрь и проверить, что случилось, однако сделать это в сопровождении другого лица.
При входе в помещение задержать дыхание, найти место утечки газа и заклеить отверстие кусочком клейкой ленты.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Проинформировать специалиста по технике безопасности судна, который проведет оценку рисков и даст указания относительно необходимых мер предосторожности.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 某个步入式冷藏间没有使用有一段时间了，需要清洁。在打开的门附近站立时，人们会感觉到一些头晕，怀疑冷却系统存在泄漏，需要维修。此时您打算怎么办？
options: 通知船只安全官，他会执行风险评估，并提出必要的安全预防措施建议。
没什么特别的，只是一个冷藏间，一切正常。
进到里面并检查，确保别人跟您一起进入。
进入时屏住呼吸，找到气体泄漏位置，在孔上贴上一些胶带。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 通知船只安全官，他会执行风险评估，并提出必要的安全预防措施建议。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Una cella frigorifera è rimasta fuori servizio per un lungo periodo e ora deve essere pulita.  Stando in piedi vicino alla porta aperta, ci si sente girare un po' la testa e viene il dubbio che possa esservi una perdita dal sistema di refrigerazione, che in questo caso dovrebbe essere riparato.  Cosa bisogna fare?
options: Avvisare il responsabile della sicurezza della nave, che eseguirà una valutazione del rischio e indicherà le precauzioni da adottare.
Niente di particolare. È solo un frigorifero e non ci saranno problemi.
Entrare nella cella frigorifera e verificare insieme a un collega.
Trattenere il respiro entrando, individuare la perdita di gas e sigillarla con del nastro adesivo.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Avvisare il responsabile della sicurezza della nave, che eseguirà una valutazione del rischio e indicherà le precauzioni da adottare.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Une chambre froide est restée hors service pendant un certain laps de temps et doit être nettoyée.  Quand les membres de l'équipage passent près de la porte de la chambre froide, ils sont pris de vertiges, et suspectent donc une fuite au niveau du système de refroidissement pour laquelle une réparation s'avère nécessaire.  Que devez-vous faire ?
options: En informer le responsable de la sécurité du navire, qui procédera à une évaluation des risques et vous conseillera sur les précautions de sécurité à prendre
Rien de spécial, ce n'est qu'une chambre froide, tout va bien se passer
Y entrer pour inspecter les lieux, accompagné(e) d'un(e) collègue
Retenir votre respiration en entrant, localiser la fuite de gaz et la colmater avec du ruban adhésif
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: En informer le responsable de la sécurité du navire, qui procédera à une évaluation des risques et vous conseillera sur les précautions de sécurité à prendre

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: How should wooden cutting boards be arranged immediately after they have been washed?
options: They should be stacked in such a way that air can flow over all surfaces.
They should be stacked flat, one on top of the other.
They should be stacked vertically, packed close together.
They should be placed in the top of a warm oven for five minutes.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: They should be stacked in such a way that air can flow over all surfaces.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Как правильно обращаться с разделочными досками сразу после их мытья?
options: Их необходимо разместить таким образом, чтобы воздух свободно циркулировал по всем поверхностям.
Их необходимо положить горизонтально, одна на другую.
Их необходимо разместить вертикально, вплотную друг к другу.
Их необходимо положить на пять минут поверх нагретого духового шкафа.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Их необходимо разместить таким образом, чтобы воздух свободно циркулировал по всем поверхностям.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 木制切割案板清洗之后应该立即如何存放？
options: 堆放时应该让其所有表面都存在空气气流。
应该水平堆放，互相叠在一起。
应该垂直堆放，互相紧紧靠在一起。
应该放入烤箱内五分钟。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 堆放时应该让其所有表面都存在空气气流。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Come vanno riposti i taglieri subito dopo essere stati lavati?
options: Devono essere impilati in modo che l'aria possa circolare su tutte le superfici durante l'asciugatura.
Devono essere impilati in orizzontale l'uno sull'altro.
Devono essere riposti in verticale, uno accanto all'altro.
Devono essere tenuti sopra un forno caldo per cinque minuti.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Devono essere impilati in modo che l'aria possa circolare su tutte le superfici durante l'asciugatura.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Comment faut-il ranger les planches à découper en bois directement après leur nettoyage ?
options: Elles doivent être rangées de sorte que l'air puisse circuler sur toutes les surfaces
Elles doivent être empilées à plat, les unes sur les autres
Elles doivent être rangées verticalement, les unes proches des autres
Elles doivent être placées au-dessus d'un four chaud pendant cinq minutes
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Elles doivent être rangées de sorte que l'air puisse circuler sur toutes les surfaces

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Why must all open wounds, once treated, then be covered with a suitable protective dressing, such as a waterproof band-aid or special sleeve or glove?
options: To further protect the casualty against secondary infection and to protect others against blood-borne bacterial infection.
So that everyone else knows the casualty has had an accident.
To protect the wound against hot water.
So that the casualty can resume working as soon as possible.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: To further protect the casualty against secondary infection and to protect others against blood-borne bacterial infection.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Для чего все открытые раны после обработки должны быть закрыты соответствующей защитной повязкой, такой как водонепроницаемый бактерицидный пластырь, специальный защитный нарукавник или перчатка?
options: Для предотвращения вторичного заражения пострадавшего и защиты окружающих от распространения бактериальной инфекции.
Для того чтобы все знали о том, что пострадавший получил травму.
Для защиты раны от горячей воды.
Для того чтобы пострадавший мог как можно скорее приступить к работе.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Для предотвращения вторичного заражения пострадавшего и защиты окружающих от распространения бактериальной инфекции.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 所有开口一旦处理之后，则必须使用合适的防护包扎进行覆盖，如防水绷带或特制护套或手套，这是为什么？
options: 为了进一步保护受害人免受二次感染，以及保护其他人不会受到血液细菌感染。
这样其他人就知道受害人有事故了。
为了保护伤口免着热水。
这样受害人就能尽快回复工作了。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 为了进一步保护受害人免受二次感染，以及保护其他人不会受到血液细菌感染。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Perché tutte le ferite aperte, una volta trattate, devono essere coperte con un idoneo bendaggio, come un cerotto impermeabile, una manichetta o un guanto?
options: Per proteggere l'infortunato da una possibile infezione secondaria, oltre che per proteggere gli altri da infezioni batteriche trasmesse dal sangue.
Per far sapere a tutti che l'infortunato ha avuto incidente.
Per proteggere la ferita dall'acqua bollente.
Per far sì che l'infortunato possa riprendere il lavoro il più presto possibile.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Per proteggere l'infortunato da una possibile infezione secondaria, oltre che per proteggere gli altri da infezioni batteriche trasmesse dal sangue.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Une fois traitées, pourquoi faut-il couvrir toutes les plaies ouvertes à l'aide d'un pansement protecteur adapté, tel qu'un pansement imperméable à l'eau de couleur ou des manches adaptées/gants spéciaux ?
options: Pour protéger la victime d'une infection secondaire et pour éviter toute transmission d'infection bactérienne par le sang
Pour que tout le monde sache que le blessé a été victime d'un accident
Pour protéger la blessure de tout contact avec de l'eau chaude
Pour que la victime puisse reprendre le travail le plus rapidement possible
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Pour protéger la victime d'une infection secondaire et pour éviter toute transmission d'infection bactérienne par le sang

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: In general, what speed setting should I use on galley electrical equipment?
options: That required for the task and as recommended in the operating instructions.
The fastest possible, in order to save time.
I should always start with the fastest and reduce the speed if necessary.
The slowest.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: That required for the task and as recommended in the operating instructions.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Какой режим скорости, как правило, следует использовать на кухонном электрооборудовании?
options: Режим скорости, соответствующий выполняемой операции, согласно руководству по эксплуатации.
Как можно более быстрый в целях экономии времени.
Всегда следует начинать эксплуатацию на максимальной скорости, снижая ее далее при необходимости.
На минимальной скорости.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Режим скорости, соответствующий выполняемой операции, согласно руководству по эксплуатации.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: 一般情况下，对于厨房电器设备应使用什么速度设置？
options: 根据任务要求和操作说明中的建议。
尽可能最快的速度，为了节省时间。
总是应该从最快速度开始，如有必要再降低速度。
最慢速度。
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: 根据任务要求和操作说明中的建议。

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: In generale, su quale valore si deve impostare la velocità degli apparecchi elettrici della cambusa?
options: Su quello richiesto per l'operazione da effettuare, secondo le istruzioni contenute nel relativo manuale.
Su quello più elevato possibile, per risparmiare tempo.
Bisogna sempre iniziare con la velocità maggiore e poi ridurla se necessario.
Su quello più basso.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Su quello richiesto per l'operazione da effettuare, secondo le istruzioni contenute nel relativo manuale.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: De manière générale, quel est le réglage de vitesse qu'il convient d'utiliser pour les équipements électriques en cuisine ?
options: Le réglage requis pour la tâche, comme recommandé dans le mode d'emploi
Le réglage le plus rapide possible, pour gagner du temps
Le réglage le plus rapide possible, qui peut ensuite être réduit si nécessaire
Le réglage le plus lent
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Le réglage requis pour la tâche, comme recommandé dans le mode d'emploi

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: The large walk-in freezer on your ship has a door secured by a padlock.  Which of the following is a good policy to follow when working inside?
options: Carry the padlock with you, so that nobody thinks it has been forgotten and re-secures the door with you still inside.
Put the padlock on the deck, close to the door, so that it doesn’t get lost.
Leave a notice in the galley that you are down below in the freezer.
Only work in the freezer where you can keep watch on the door.
CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.answer: Carry the padlock with you, so that nobody thinks it has been forgotten and re-secures the door with you still inside.

CD0220 — Galley Operations, Workplace an.question: Дверь в просторную морозильную камеру на вашем судне закрывается на навесной замок.  Какое из нижеперечисленных правил необходимо соблюдать, работая внутри камеры?
options: Следует взять замок внутрь, с тем чтобы никто не подумал, что дверь забыли закрыть, и не закрыл дверь, когда вы находитесь внутри.
