CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: In relation to an electrical motor: which of the following best describes what a ‘star point’ is?
options: It is the point at which one of the ends of all 3 windings are shorted together
It is the point where the end of one winding is connected to the start of the next
It is a point provided for test equipment
It is the point at which the motor is unable to turn
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: It is the point at which one of the ends of all 3 windings are shorted together

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: In relation to electrical systems: which of the following best describes what the definition of ‘power’ is?
options: Power is the rate of energy conversion
Power is the amount of energy converted
Power is the amount of electricity available at any point in the system
Power is the rate of generator fuel being burnt
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: Power is the rate of energy conversion

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which of the following best describes the relationship between the current and voltage in a circuit with pure capacitance which is supplied with single phase AC?
options: The peak current will lead that of the voltage by 90°
The peak current will lag that of the voltage by 90°
The current and voltage will reach their maximum at the same time
The voltage cycle does not affect the times at which the current reaches its maximum
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: The peak current will lead that of the voltage by 90°

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Here are the terminal connections on an electric induction motor. Which of the following best describes the arrangement?
options: 3 phase - Delta connected
3 phase - Star connected
3 phase - Star connected with insulated neutral
3 phase - Star connected with earthed neutral
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: 3 phase - Delta connected

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which one of the following is an example of an electrical load with a power factor of approximately one?
options: A galley hotplate
An induction motor while starting
An induction motor while running
A fluorescent light
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: A galley hotplate

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which of the following best describes what will happen to the current in this capacitive electrical circuit when the switch is closed?
options: A current will flow clockwise but will fall to zero^Mafter a time
A current will flow anticlockwise but will fall to^Mzero after a time
A current will flow anticlockwise
No current will flow
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: A current will flow clockwise but will fall to zero^Mafter a time

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which one of the following describes the way of calculating the amount of electrical energy that can be stored in a capacitor?
options: Energy stored is = ½ CV ² Joules
Energy stored is = ½ CV ² Watts
Energy stored is = ½ LI ² Joules
Energy stored is = ½ LI ² Watts
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: Energy stored is = ½ CV ² Joules

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: The power factor of a large electric motor changes from 0.8 to 0.7 while its kW load remains constant. Which of the following best describes the effect of this on the electrical network?
options: The current taken from the network will increase
The network power factor will be automatically increased to compensate for the change
The network will not be affected as the active power has not changed
The current taken from the network will decrease
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: The current taken from the network will increase

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Here are the terminal connections on an electrical machine. Which of the following best describes the arrangement?
options: 3 phase - Star connected with neutral
3 phase - Delta connected with neutral
4 phase - Star connected
3 phase - Delta connected with split winding
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: 3 phase - Star connected with neutral

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which of the following best describes the relationship between the current and voltage in a circuit with pure inductance which is supplied with single phase AC?
options: The current will reach its maximum 90° after the voltage reaches its maximum
The current will reach its maximum 90° before the voltage reaches its maximum
The current and voltage will reach their maximum at the same time
The voltage cycle does not affect the times at which the current reaches its maximum
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: The current will reach its maximum 90° after the voltage reaches its maximum

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: What is the minimum number of stator coils required to make a 3 phase electrical generator?
options: 2 pairs

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: With regard to a star connected electrical machine: which one of the following statements is true?
options: The phase current is the same as the line current
The phase voltage is the same as the line voltage
The phase current is smaller than the line current
The phase voltage is larger the line voltage
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: The phase current is the same as the line current

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which one of the following describes a way of increasing the Capacitance value of a capacitor?
options: Increase the area of the conducting plates
Reduce the area of the conducting plates
Increase the voltage applied to the conducting plates
Reduce the voltage applied to the conducting plates
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: Increase the area of the conducting plates

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which one of the following are the units used when measuring capacitance in an electrical component?
options: Farads
Coulombs
Teslas
Teslas per metre²
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: Farads

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: With regard to a delta connected electrical machine: which one of the following statements is true?
options: The line voltage is the same as the phase voltage
The line current is the same as the phase current
The line voltage is larger than the phase voltage
The line current is smaller than the phase current
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: The line voltage is the same as the phase voltage

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which of the following best describes one of the major problems with using only single phase electricity for a ship’s electrical system?
options: The torque variations cause excessive torsional vibrations in single phase machines
Single phase machines require higher maintenance
Single phase networks require more conductors
Single phase networks require fewer conductors with larger diameters
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: The torque variations cause excessive torsional vibrations in single phase machines

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Study of an electrical circuit results in the calculation of current phasors for resistive, inductive and capacitive components of the total current as shown. If the circuit voltage is 200 V what will be the value of reactive power (Q)?
options: Q = 2,000 VAr
Q = 5,000 VAr
Q = 8,000 VAr
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: Q = 2,000 VAr

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which of the following is the best description of a ‘current’ in an electrical circuit?
options: A flow of electrons
A flow of protons
A flow of neutrons
The energy that produces a voltage
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: A flow of electrons

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: When considering an electromagnet which one of the following factors effects its relative permeability?
options: The material of the core
The current applied
The voltage applied
The diameter of the coil
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: The material of the core

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: An electrical network consists of 3 loads with different power factors. Which of the following best describes how the overall network power factor can be calculated?
options: The three powers would need to be added together using vector addition
The three powers would need to be added together using simple  addition
The apparent powers of all 3 loads can be added together and divided by the total power
The arithmetic mean of the three power factors can be used
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: The three powers would need to be added together using vector addition

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which one of the following best describes why it is preferable to use electromagnets when constructing an electrical generator, rather than permanent magnets?
options: We can control the amount of flux that electromagnets produce
The electromagnets are bigger and therefore more robust
The electromagnets are easier to shape
We need conductors around the magnets to carry the generator output
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: We can control the amount of flux that electromagnets produce

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which of the following correctly describes what is happening at the instant represented by this phasor diagram?
options: The value of current is zero
The value of current is falling
The current leads the voltage
The value of voltage is falling
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: The value of current is zero

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which one of the following can be assumed to have an unchanging value in an electrical circuit, whether it is an AC or DC circuit?
options: Resistance
Inductance
Capacitance
Impedance
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: Resistance

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which of the following best describes the construction of a simple electrical capacitor?
options: Two conducting plates separated by a gap of a dielectric substance
Two conducting plates separated by a semi conductor
Two insulating plates separated by a conducting substance
Loops of conductor separated by an insulating substance
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: Two conducting plates separated by a gap of a dielectric substance

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: With reference to an AC electrical circuit: which of the following best describes the meaning of ‘in phase’?
options: The voltage and current rise and fall together
The voltage starts to rise as the current starts to fall
The voltage and current have the same value
The circuit contains a resistor in series with an inductor
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: The voltage and current rise and fall together

CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.question: Which one of the following best describes why physical forces can be created from the interaction of 2 magnets?
options: The magnets move to make the lines of magnetic flux as short as possible
The magnets move because of an electrical charge stored within them
The magnets move to even out the flux density
The magnets move if the lines of magnetic flux are forced to cross
CD0234 — Electric Propulsion, Fundamenta.answer: The magnets move to make the lines of magnetic flux as short as possible

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes the term ‘slip’ when applied to an asynchronous electric motor?
options: It is the difference between the rotor speed and the synchronous speed
It is the difference between the rotor speed and the synchronous speed only when measured during start up acceleration
It is the difference between speed of the load and the speed of the rotor
It is the difference between speed of the load and the speed of the rotor during start up acceleration
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: It is the difference between the rotor speed and the synchronous speed

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes the effect of a current carrying conductor when a magnetic field is moved across it?
options: The conductor will try to move
The current flow in the conductor will increase
The current flow in the conductor will reduce
There will be no effect
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The conductor will try to move

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes how a solenoid works?
options: A current in the coil produces a magnetic field which moves an iron rod
A current in the coil produces a magnetic field which moves a copper rod
A current in the coil induces an opposing current in an iron rod
A current in the central rod overcomes the permanent magnetic field around it
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: A current in the coil produces a magnetic field which moves an iron rod

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes why the rotor of an asynchronous electric motor can never rotate at synchronous speed?
options: At synchronous speed the rotor would feel no change in stator flux and so would produce no current to make its own field
The rotor construction is not strong enough to stand running at synchronous speed
The number of pole pairs in an asynchronous motor is different in the rotor and stator so their synchronous speeds are always different
The rotor can reach synchronous speed but will lag behind the stator position
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: At synchronous speed the rotor would feel no change in stator flux and so would produce no current to make its own field

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes what happens when 2 magnets are placed next to each other with their North poles alongside each other?
options: Their fields will be distorted and the flux density^Mbetween them will increase
Their fields will be distorted and the flux density^Mbetween them will decrease
They will jump together
Their magnetic fields are in the same direction,^Mso there will be no change in flux density
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: Their fields will be distorted and the flux density^Mbetween them will increase

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes the convention for the magnetic field produced when a conductor carries an electrical current flowing directly away from you?
options: The flux runs clockwise around the conductor
The flux runs anticlockwise around the^Mconductor
The flux runs in the opposite direction to the^Mcurrent
The flux runs in the same direction as the^Mcurrent
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The flux runs clockwise around the conductor

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes the reason why the commutator of a DC machine has so many individual segments?
options: Each armature conductor on the rotor must have its polarity reversed twice per revolution
Each coil on the rotor must have its polarity reversed twice per revolution
Each armature conductor on the rotor must have its polarity reversed four times per revolution
The number of commutator segments is determined by the need to convert the AC supply frequency to DC while the motor turns
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: Each armature conductor on the rotor must have its polarity reversed twice per revolution

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes the electrical output when a magnet is rotated at a steady RPM inside a fixed coil?
options: The output is a sine wave
The output is a steady DC voltage
The output is a square wave
The output is a steady DC voltage which alternates in direction
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The output is a sine wave

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes how 3 phase electricity can be produced from a diesel generator?
options: We need at least 3 coils, so there are 3 outputs
We need at least 6 coils, so there are 6 outputs
We need at least 6 coils, so there are 12 terminals
We need only 1 coil, and the output can be split using thyristors
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: We need at least 3 coils, so there are 3 outputs

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes what happens when the brushes of a DC motor reach a gap in the commutator?
options: The conductor not being supplied is moving parallel to the magnetic field and so would produce little force
The conductor not being supplied would be subject to maximum current so time for cooling is created
The conductor not being supplied is moving at right angles to the field and so would produce little force
The change in current in the conductor not being supplied generates a boost to the rotation
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The conductor not being supplied is moving parallel to the magnetic field and so would produce little force

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following is an application where a DC motor is likely to be used?
options: A servo motor
A sea water pump motor
An air compressor motor
A pump room fan motor
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: A servo motor

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes the basic operation of the voltage control system of a typical large modern synchronous AC generator?
options: The voltage regulator changes the main field strength by controlling the output of an exciter
The voltage regulator changes the main field strength by means of a sliding permanent magnet
The voltage regulator changes the driving engine speed by controlling its governor
The voltage regulator controls the back EMF through a set of brushes and slip rings
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The voltage regulator changes the main field strength by controlling the output of an exciter

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes how ‘brushless rectification’ is carried out to supply the field coils of a typical synchronous AC generator?
options: The output of an AC exciter is converted to DC by rectifiers mounted on the shaft
A DC output is taken from the rotor of a DC exciter
A DC exciter is used with a commutator instead of slip rings
An external DC supply is fed to the rotor through slip rings
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The output of an AC exciter is converted to DC by rectifiers mounted on the shaft

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes why DC motors are normally fitted with brushes and commutators?
options: The armature is mounted on the rotor and must be supplied with electricity
The frame is mounted on the rotor and must be supplied with electricity
The rotor is prone to dirt build up and must be cleaned
The stator must be supplied via the commutator
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The armature is mounted on the rotor and must be supplied with electricity

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes what is between the segments of a DC machine’s commutator?
options: Insulation
Glue
A groove cut in the solid commutator
A wear down sensor
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: Insulation

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: A 3 phase synchronous AC motor is supplied at 60 Hz. If the supply frequency falls by 3% what will be the effect on the motor speed?
options: It will also fall by 3%
It will be unchanged
It will rise by 3%
It will fall by 9%
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: It will also fall by 3%

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes why single phase AC generators are more likely to suffer from mechanical failure than 3 phase machines?
options: Single phase generators tend to have larger torsional vibrations
Single phase generators tend to be smaller
Single phase generators tend to be lower quality
Single phase generators tend to be used for larger capacities
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: Single phase generators tend to have larger torsional vibrations

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes the electrical output when a coil is rotated at a steady RPM in a fixed magnetic field?
options: The output is a sine wave
The output is a steady DC voltage
The output is a square wave
The output is a steady DC voltage which changes direction
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The output is a sine wave

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes the main criteria when designing an electrical generator?
options: The conductors and magnetic field must move in relation to each other
The conductors must be stationary and the magnetic field must rotate
The magnetic field must be stationary and the conductors must rotate
The conductors and magnetic field must move at the same speed
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The conductors and magnetic field must move in relation to each other

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes the main difference in the construction between a 3 phase and a single phase AC generator
options: The 3 phase generator has 3 pairs of stator coils and the single phase generator only 1 pair
The single phase generator has 3 pairs of rotor coils and the 3 phase generator only 1 pair
The 3 phase generator has no commutator and the single phase generator does
The single phase generator has no commutator and the 3 phase generator does
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The 3 phase generator has 3 pairs of stator coils and the single phase generator only 1 pair

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes how a synchronous AC motor can be used to reduce a lagging power factor on a network?
options: By increasing the strength of its rotor field
By reversing its direction
By running it above synchronous speed
By arranging it for dynamic compensation
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: By increasing the strength of its rotor field

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes when the back EMF produced in a DC machine will be higher than the terminal voltage?
options: When the machine is run as a generator
When the machine is run as a motor
When the machine is run as a synchronous compensator
When a supply is first connected to the machine
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: When the machine is run as a generator

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following is the most accurate description of the magnetic field of a synchronous AC generator?
options: The field is produced from an electromagnetic pole arrangement supplied with a DC current
The field is produced from an electromagnet pole arrangement supplied with an AC current
The field is produced from a molybdenum permanent magnet pole arrangement
The field is produced from an electromagnet pole arrangement  with a fixed strength
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The field is produced from an electromagnetic pole arrangement supplied with a DC current

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following statements about synchronous and asynchronous AC electrical machines is correct?
options: The asynchronous machine has no separately controlled field supply
A synchronous machine has no separately controlled field supply
The speed of the synchronous machine cannot be controlled
The speed of the synchronous machine is dependent on its ‘slip’
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The asynchronous machine has no separately controlled field supply

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes the affect on a conductor passing from left to right through a magnetic field if its direction of travel is reversed?
options: The voltage produced in it will be reversed
The voltage produced in it will be increased
The voltage produced in it will be reduced
The voltage produced in it will stay the same
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The voltage produced in it will be reversed

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes the affect on a conductor when passing a magnetic field if the strength of the field is doubled?
options: The voltage produced in it will be doubled
The voltage produced in it will be halved
The voltage produced in it will be quadrupled
The voltage produced in it will stay the same
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The voltage produced in it will be doubled

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes the difference between the 2 basic types of asynchronous AC electrical machines?
options: One has a wound rotor and slip rings, the other has a cage rotor without slip rings
One has a wound rotor without slip rings, the other has a cage rotor and slip rings
One has a wound rotor and a commutator, the other has a cage rotor without a commutator
One has a wound rotor and the other has a cage rotor. Neither has slip rings
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: One has a wound rotor and slip rings, the other has a cage rotor without slip rings

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes the meaning of ‘synchronous’ when applied to electrical generators?
options: The stator output frequency varies in direct proportion to the speed of the rotor
The stator output voltage varies in direct proportion to the speed of the rotor
The stator output frequency is always the same as the main switchboard frequency
The stator output frequency is fixed
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The stator output frequency varies in direct proportion to the speed of the rotor

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: A DC motor is driving a load at constant torque. Which one of the following best describes how best to reduce the speed of the motor?
options: Increase the magnetic field density
Decrease the field coil current
Increase the armature current
Switch in the starting resistors
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: Increase the magnetic field density

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes why an electric induction motor takes a large current when starting?
options: The low resistance of the rotor conductors and the high rate of change in the magnetic field passing over them causes the large starting current
The low resistance of the stator conductors causes the large starting current
The slow rate of change in the magnetic field within the rotor causes the large starting current
The load needs to be accelerated, which takes more current
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The low resistance of the rotor conductors and the high rate of change in the magnetic field passing over them causes the large starting current

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following describes the forms of energy used on ships in the process of producing electrical energy?
options: Chemical energy, mechanical energy then electrical energy
Mechanical energy then electrical energy
Mechanical energy, chemical energy then electrical energy
Electrostatic energy then electrical energy
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: Chemical energy, mechanical energy then electrical energy

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following is the level of starting current typically taken by an electric induction motor when first started?
options: 6 - 8 times rated full load
2 - 3 times rated full load
0.6 - 0.8 times rated full load
1.25 times rated full load
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: 6 - 8 times rated full load

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following is a type of DC motor which can give accurate positional control?
options: Stepper motor
Sensor motor
Staged motor
Synchronous motor
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: Stepper motor

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes how the magnetic field is created in the cage rotor of an electric induction motor?
options: Current is produced in the rotor conductors by transformer action. This creates an electromagnetic field
Current is passed to the rotor conductors by brushes. This creates an electromagnetic field
The cage of the rotor is made of highly magnetic materials
A magnetic field is induced in the rotor cage of opposite polarity to that in the nearest stator winding
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: Current is produced in the rotor conductors by transformer action. This creates an electromagnetic field

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following is a way of increasing the torque output of a DC motor without losing speed?
options: Increase the field density
Decrease the field density
Increase the armature current
Decrease the armature current
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: Increase the field density

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes the usual meaning of ‘EMF’ when talking about electrical machines?
options: Electromotive force
Electromagnetic field
Electro mechanical force
Electromagnetic force
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: Electromotive force

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following best describes the affect on a conductor when passed through a magnetic field at double the previous speed?
options: The voltage produced in it will be doubled
The voltage produced in it will be halved
The voltage produced in it will be quadrupled
The voltage produced in it will stay the same
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The voltage produced in it will be doubled

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which one of the following is a correct statement in relation to the speed of a DC motor?
options: The speed is proportional to the back EMF
The speed is inversely proportional to the back EMF
The speed is proportional to the flux density
The speed is fixed by the number of pole pairs
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The speed is proportional to the back EMF

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: The most common AC motor has a cage type rotor. Which one of the following best describes this type of rotor?
options: It has a set of parallel conductors fixed around an iron core which are shorted together at each end
It has a set of parallel conductors fixed around a copper core which are not connected at the ends
It has a set of conductors wound around a ring of iron cores
It is made up of 3 conductor ‘cages’ fitted one inside the others
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: It has a set of parallel conductors fixed around an iron core which are shorted together at each end

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Which of the following best describes what happens to an electric induction motor if more torque is needed to turn the pump it is driving?
options: The rotor will slow down and the supply current will increase
The supply current will increase but the rotor will stay at the same speed
The rotor will speed up, which reduces the torque needed
The rotor will slow down but the supply current will stay the same
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: The rotor will slow down and the supply current will increase

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: If an electric induction motor is supplied at 50 Hz and contains 1 pair of poles what is its synchronous speed?
options: 50 revs/s 	(3,000 RPM)
25 revs/s 	(1,500 RPM)
30 revs/s 	(1,800 RPM)
60 revs/s 	(3,600 RPM)
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: 50 revs/s 	(3,000 RPM)

CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.question: Some larger electric induction motors have the number of starting attempts limited during a set time period. Which one of the following best describes why this is done?
options: Too many high starting currents in a short time may overheat the motor and associated control equipment
Too many high motor starting currents in a short time may overload the generator
Too many high starting currents in a short time may cause damage to the motor drive coupling and shaft
Too many high starting currents in a short time mean that there is a problem with the equipment the motor is driving
CD0235 — Electric Propulsion, Electrical.answer: Too many high starting currents in a short time may overheat the motor and associated control equipment

CD0236 — Electric Propulsion, Power elec.question: Which of the following best describes the possible result of uncontrolled triggering of a transistor in the inverter circuit of a speed controller?
options: It could cause a short circuit.
It could cause the motor to reverse.
It could cause the motor to speed up.
It could cause the motor to slow down.
CD0236 — Electric Propulsion, Power elec.answer: It could cause a short circuit.

CD0236 — Electric Propulsion, Power elec.question: Which one of the following best describes what happens when a diode is connected in a circuit with an AC supply as shown?
options: The resistor will receive a half wave rectified DC voltage.
The resistor will receive a full wave rectified DC voltage.
The diode will prevent a current from flowing in the circuit.
The resistor will receive an AC voltage of half the supply voltage.
CD0236 — Electric Propulsion, Power elec.answer: The resistor will receive a half wave rectified DC voltage.

CD0236 — Electric Propulsion, Power elec.question: Which of the following best describes what happens when a diode becomes ‘reverse biased’?
options: Conduction will stop.
Conduction will start.
The diode will start to conduct if a gate pulse is received.
The diode output will be reversed.
CD0236 — Electric Propulsion, Power elec.answer: Conduction will stop.

CD0236 — Electric Propulsion, Power elec.question: Which one of the following best describes a potential cause of damage to power electronic devices while they are being handled?
options: Static discharge from wearing man-made fabrics.
Conductor etching due to fingerprints.
Excessive heat from hands.
Excessive vibration when stored onboard.
CD0236 — Electric Propulsion, Power elec.answer: Static discharge from wearing man-made fabrics.

CD0236 — Electric Propulsion, Power elec.question: Which of the following best describes why diodes in power circuits need to be cooled while operating?
options: There is a forward voltage drop which causes heat to be given off.
Heat is caused while the diode is stopping current flow.
The control circuits for the diodes operate at high currents.
High voltages cause high heat generation.
CD0236 — Electric Propulsion, Power elec.answer: There is a forward voltage drop which causes heat to be given off.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Затянуть тормоз брашпиля, наложить палубный стопор, дать машине ход и разорвать зацепление.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 如果深水中的锚好像已经着床，将其拉起的最好方式是什么？
options: 施加起锚机制动器，接合船首制链器，使用轮机移动船舶，松开抓地。
让起锚机向前移动一点，然后反向移动，松开抓地
使用起锚机马达，用短促的较大力量抬起并松开抓地
等待潮汐慢慢让船舶转向，松开抓地
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 施加起锚机制动器，接合船首制链器，使用轮机移动船舶，松开抓地。

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: What risk is associated with using two anchors to moor a vessel?
options: The anchor cables fouling each other.
The vessel swinging rapidly at change of tide.
The vessel dragging one anchor.
The vessel dragging both anchors.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: The anchor cables fouling each other.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: В чем заключается риск постановки судна на два якоря?
options: Спутывание якорных цепей.
Быстрый разворот судна при смене приливно-отливных течений.
Дрейф судна на одном якоре.
Дрейф судна на двух якорях.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Спутывание якорных цепей.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 使用双锚系泊船舶时的风险是什么？
options: 锚线缆互相绞缠。
发生潮汐变化时船舶快速回转。
船舶拖拽一个锚。
船舶拖拽两个锚。
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 锚线缆互相绞缠。

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: When using two anchors, if one anchor starts dragging, how can this situation be corrected?
options: By allowing the first anchor to drag until both cables lead the same way, then paying out both cables together.
By paying out both cables together.
By using the engine to stop the anchor from dragging.
By running the engine astern.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: By allowing the first anchor to drag until both cables lead the same way, then paying out both cables together.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Если при постановке на два якоря один из них начинает ползти, как можно исправить ситуацию?
options: Позволив этому якорю ползти до тех пор, пока углы наклона обеих цепей не станут одинаковыми, при этом одновременно стравливая обе цепи.
Стравливая обе цепи одновременно.
Дав машине ход, чтобы остановить дрейф на якоре.
Дав задний ход.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Позволив этому якорю ползти до тех пор, пока углы наклона обеих цепей не станут одинаковыми, при этом одновременно стравливая обе цепи.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 使用双锚时，如果一个锚开始拖拽，可以如何修复此情况？
options: 允许第一个锚拖拽，直到两个线缆方向相同，然后一起松开两个线缆。
一起放出两个线缆。
使用轮机停止锚的拖拽。
向后运行轮机。
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 允许第一个锚拖拽，直到两个线缆方向相同，然后一起松开两个线缆。

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: When are two anchors used to moor a vessel?
options: When it is necessary to restrict the arc that a vessel moves through at the anchorage whilst swinging.
To make sure that a vessel does not swing at the anchorage.
To prevent a vessel from dragging anchor.
To prevent an anchor cable from taking charge, causing heat-fade of the brake lining.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: When it is necessary to restrict the arc that a vessel moves through at the anchorage whilst swinging.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: В каких случаях судно ставится на два якоря?
options: Когда необходимо ограничить радиус, по которому судно обращается вокруг якоря на стоянке.
Чтобы гарантировать, что судно не будет обращаться вокруг якоря на стоянке.
Чтобы предотвратить дрейф судна на якоре.
Чтобы предотвратить чрезмерную нагрузку на якорную цепь, что вызывает износ тормозных колодок из-за перегрева.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Когда необходимо ограничить радиус, по которому судно обращается вокруг якоря на стоянке.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 何时使用两个锚来系泊船舶？
options: 必需限制船舶在锚地回转时的弧形时。
确保船舶不会在锚地进行回转时。
防止船舶拖拽锚时。
防止锚线缆受力，避免制动线发生高温衰减时。
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 必需限制船舶在锚地回转时的弧形时。

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Which one of the following statements best describes when walking out anchor all the way is most likely to be used?
options: On vessels over 50,000 tonnes deadweight.
Only on VLCCs
On vessels below 50,000 tonnes deadweight.
On fully loaded Panamax vessels.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: On vessels over 50,000 tonnes deadweight.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Какое из следующих утверждений лучше всего описывает ситуации, когда наиболее вероятно будет использовано стравливание якоря на всю длину?
options: На судах с грузоподъемностью свыше 50 000 тонн.
Только на супертанкерах.
На судах с грузоподъемностью менее 50 000 тонн.
Только на полностью груженых танкерах класса «Панамакс».
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: На судах с грузоподъемностью свыше 50 000 тонн.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 下面哪个说法最好地描述了最可能使用一路放出锚的情况？
options: 自重超过 50,000 吨的船舶上。
仅在 VLCC 上
自重低于 50,000 吨的船舶上。
满载的 Panamax 船舶上。
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 自重超过 50,000 吨的船舶上。

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: What is the primary risk associated with walking out anchor all the way?
options: Straining the windlass.
Loss of anchor cable.
Damage to bow plating.
Heat-fade of the windlass brake.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Straining the windlass.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Какой основной риск связан со стравливанием якоря на всю длину?
options: Перегрузка брашпиля.
Потеря якорной цепи.
Повреждение обшивки носовой части судна.
Износ тормоза брашпиля из-за перегрева.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Перегрузка брашпиля.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 与一路放出锚相关联的主要风险是什么？
options: 让起锚机受力。
丢失锚线缆。
损坏船首外板。
起锚机制动器的高温衰减。
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 让起锚机受力。

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: With regard to walking out anchor all the way, what is the particular risk with a fully laden tanker with bow over-hang?
options: Difficulty in ensuring that the anchor cable is up-and–down.
Difficulty in determining the anchoring location.
Difficulty in ensuring that the anchor cable is at short stay.
Difficulty in ensuring that the anchor is aweigh.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Difficulty in ensuring that the anchor cable is up-and–down.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Какой особый риск, касающийся стравливания якоря на всю длину, связан с полностью груженным танкером со свесом носовой части?
options: Сложно убедиться, что якорная цепь находится в положении «панер».
Трудность в определении места отдачи якоря.
Сложно убедиться, что якорная цепь находится в вертикальном положении.
Сложно убедиться, что «якорь встал».
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Сложно убедиться, что якорная цепь находится в положении «панер».

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 关于一路放出锚，与船首突出的全载荷油轮相连的具体风险是什么？
options: 确保锚线缆直上直下的困难。
确定锚位的困难。
确保锚线缆处于短停留状态的困难。
确保锚离开水面的困难。
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 确保锚线缆直上直下的困难。

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: When a vessel drags anchor, why is more cable veered?
options: To improve the Scope, increasing the weight of anchor chain.
To reduce the vessel swinging to the wind and current.
To increase the vessel’s swinging circle at change of tide.
To drop back so that the second anchor can be let go
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: To improve the Scope, increasing the weight of anchor chain.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Для чего дополнительно стравливают цепь, когда судно дрейфует на якоре?
options: Чтобы сделать более оптимальным отношение длины вытравленной якорной цепи к глубине путем увеличения длины цепи.
Чтобы уменьшить радиус циркуляции судна под действием ветра и течения.
Чтобы увеличить радиус циркуляции судна при смене приливно-отливных течений.
Чтобы отойти назад для отдачи второго якоря.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Чтобы сделать более оптимальным отношение длины вытравленной якорной цепи к глубине путем увеличения длины цепи.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 当船舶拖拽锚时，为什么要放出更多线缆？
options: 为了提高范围，增加锚链重量。
为了减少船舶针对风和海流的回转。
为了在潮汐变化时增加船舶回转圈。
为了后退以便可以抛出第二个锚
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 为了提高范围，增加锚链重量。

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: What is the aim of letting go anchor from just above the seabed?
options: To reduce the risk of the cable running out too quickly.
To avoid damaging the Bitter End.
To be able to ‘Dredge’ anchor.
To provide a dragging resistance to the ship’s motion.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: To reduce the risk of the cable running out too quickly.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Какова цель отдачи якоря из положения непосредственно над дном?
options: Чтобы снизить риски, связанные со слишком быстрым стравливанием цепи.
Чтобы избежать повреждения коренного конца.
Чтобы заглубить якорь в грунт.
Чтобы ползущий якорь обеспечил сопротивление движению судна.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Чтобы снизить риски, связанные со слишком быстрым стравливанием цепи.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 从海床上方抛锚的目的是什么？
options: 为了减少过快冲出线缆的风险。
为了避免损坏索端。
为了能够“捞取”锚。
为了提供拖拽阻力，防止船只移动。
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 为了减少过快冲出线缆的风险。

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: What is the particular risk associated with letting go anchor from just above the seabed?
options: Major damage to the anchor system.
Major damage to the bow plating
The vessel may ‘Squat’ by the head.
The anchor may not hold in the seabed.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Major damage to the anchor system.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: В чем заключается риск отдачи якоря из положения непосредственно над дном?
options: Значительное повреждение якорной системы.
Значительное повреждение обшивки носовой части судна.
Может увеличиться осадка носом.
Якорь может не забрать грунт.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Значительное повреждение якорной системы.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 从海床上方抛锚的具体风险是什么？
options: 对锚系统造成严重损坏
对船首外板造成严重损坏
船舶可能头部“蹲起”。
锚可能无法抓住海床。
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 对锚系统造成严重损坏

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: What is the greatest risk associated with the Mediterranean Moor?
options: Unavailability of tugs.
A crowded anchorage.
Squat, in a narrow channel.
Range of tide.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Unavailability of tugs.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Какой самый значительный риск связан со средиземноморским методом швартовки?
options: Отсутствие буксиров.
Место стоянки с большим количеством судов.
Увеличение осадки кормой на ходу при нахождении в узком фарватере.
Высота прилива.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Отсутствие буксиров.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 与地中海式系泊法相关的最大风险是什么？
options: 拖船不可用。
锚地拥挤。
狭窄航道中的蹲起。
潮汐的范围。
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 拖船不可用。

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Where is the Mediterranean Moor used?
options: At a shore facility where moorings can accommodate only the stern.
Where there is limited sea room
During emergencies in narrow channels.
At ports bordering the Mediterranean Sea.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: At a shore facility where moorings can accommodate only the stern.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: В каких случаях используется средиземноморский метод швартовки?
options: На береговом сооружении, где бочки могут принять только корму.
Там, где ограничено пространство для маневрирования.
В чрезвычайных ситуациях при нахождении в узком фарватере.
В портах Средиземного моря.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: На береговом сооружении, где бочки могут принять только корму.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 在什么情况下使用地中海式系泊法？
options: 在系泊位只能容纳船尾的海岸设施处。
海面空间有限时
在较窄航道中的紧急情况下。
在地中海周围港口处。
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 在系泊位只能容纳船尾的海岸设施处。

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: What particular precaution must be taken with the Mediterranean Moor?
options: The propeller must be kept clear of mooring ropes at all times.
The procedure cannot be carried out in a cross-wind.
Only one anchor can be used.
The mooring crew must wear safety goggles.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: The propeller must be kept clear of mooring ropes at all times.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Какие особые меры предосторожности необходимо предпринять при использовании средиземноморского метода швартовки?
options: Все время необходимо следить за тем, чтобы гребной винт не запутался в швартовах.
Процедуру нельзя выполнять при боковом ветре.
Можно использовать только один якорь.
Швартовщики должны носить закрытые защитные очки.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Все время необходимо следить за тем, чтобы гребной винт не запутался в швартовах.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 对于地中海式系泊法必须采取什么具体预防措施？
options: 推进器必须随时远离系泊绳索。
不能在横风情况下执行该程序。
只能使用一个锚。
系泊船员必须佩戴安全护目镜。
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 推进器必须随时远离系泊绳索。

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Which of the following is the main reason for letting go anchor from just above the sea bed?
options: To reduce the chance of the momentum of the anchor and cable becoming too high
To increase the holding power of the anchor
To speed up the anchoring process
To allow more time for the vessel to manoeuvre in the anchorage
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: To reduce the chance of the momentum of the anchor and cable becoming too high

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Какая из нижеперечисленных причин является главной для отдачи якоря из положения непосредственно над дном?
options: Для снижения вероятности чрезмерного увеличения инерции якоря и цепи.
Для повышения удерживающей силы якоря.
Для ускорения процесса постановки на якорь.
Для того чтобы у судна было больше времени на маневрирование на якорной стоянке.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Для снижения вероятности чрезмерного увеличения инерции якоря и цепи.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 下面哪个是从海床上方抛锚的主要原因？
options: 降低锚和线缆动能过高的几率
增加锚的抓力
加快停锚进程
让船舶有更多的时间在锚地操控
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 降低锚和线缆动能过高的几率

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: What is the most significant risk of letting go anchor from just above the sea bed?
options: The anchor may take hold whilst the ship speed is too high, and damage to equipment or injury to personnel may result
The anchor may not take hold properly
The anchor chain may foul the anchor
The anchor chain may foul the hull
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: The anchor may take hold whilst the ship speed is too high, and damage to equipment or injury to personnel may result

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Каков наиболее значительный риск отдачи якоря из положения непосредственно над дном?
options: Якорь может захватить грунт при слишком высокой скорости судна, и в результате этого повредить оборудование или травмировать персонал.
Якорь может не захватить грунт надлежащим образом.
Якорная цепь может запутаться вокруг якоря.
Якорная цепь может запутаться вокруг корпуса
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: Якорь может захватить грунт при слишком высокой скорости судна, и в результате этого повредить оборудование или травмировать персонал.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 在海床上方抛锚的最主要风险是什么？
options: 船只速度过快时锚可能抓地，可能损坏设备或造成人员受伤
锚可能无法恰当抓地
锚链可能与锚发生绞缠
锚可能与船体发生绞缠
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 船只速度过快时锚可能抓地，可能损坏设备或造成人员受伤

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Once a vessel is brought up, what is the advantage of disengaging the bow chain-stopper and allowing the chain cable to be held by the brake?
options: In case of bad weather, more cable can be paid out easily to increase the Scope and improve anchor holding power.
The bow stopper may get jammed by the cable link when strain increases in bad weather, requiring use of engine and windlass power to release it.
The brake has more strength than the bow chain-stopper.
Strong winds can release the bow chain-stopper.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: In case of bad weather, more cable can be paid out easily to increase the Scope and improve anchor holding power.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: После остановки судна якорем в чем заключается преимущество разобщения палубного стопора цепи, позволив тормозу удерживать якорную цепь?
options: При неблагоприятных погодных условиях можно легко дополнительно стравить цепь, чтобы увеличить отношение длины вытравленной якорной цепи к глубине, повысив удерживающую силу якоря.

При неблагоприятных погодных условиях нагрузка на якорь возрастет и звено якорной цепи может застрять в палубном стопоре, тогда для освобождения цепи потребуется дать машине ход и использовать двигатель брашпиля.
Тормоз имеет большую силу, чем палубный стопор цепи.
При сильном ветре палубный стопор цепи может отжаться.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: При неблагоприятных погодных условиях можно легко дополнительно стравить цепь, чтобы увеличить отношение длины вытравленной якорной цепи к глубине, повысив удерживающую силу якоря.

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: 船舶到位之后，断开船首制链器并让制动器固定链缆的好处是什么？
options: 恶劣天下下，可以更轻松地放出更多线缆，增加范围，提高锚抓力。
在恶劣天气下船首制链器可能会被线缆链节卡住，需要使用轮机和起锚机动力进行释放。
制动器的强度比船首制链器大。
强风会松开船首制链器。
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 恶劣天下下，可以更轻松地放出更多线缆，增加范围，提高锚抓力。

CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.question: Which one of the following options would be the best speed over the ground when dropping anchor using the windlass brakes?
options: 0.5 knots astern.
0 knots.
1 knot astern.
1.5 knots astern.
CD0247 — Anchor Mooring Procedures.answer: 0.5 knots astern.

People who are reflective and show no interest in social status are vulnerable to stress.
Perfectionist people are vulnerable to stress.
CD0257 — Stress Management.answer: People who are reflective and show no interest in social status are vulnerable to stress.

CD0257 — Stress Management.question: Which one of the following statements about chronic stress is FALSE?
options: Chronic stress arises when you feel that the situation is beyond your control.
Chronic stress is harmful and must be controlled.
Chronic stress is considered a life energy force in the body and a key ingredient of optimal performance.
Chronic stress makes our body sensitive as it tries to combat threat until we run out of energy.
CD0257 — Stress Management.answer: Chronic stress is considered a life energy force in the body and a key ingredient of optimal performance.

CD0257 — Stress Management.question: Which one of the following statements about acute stress is correct?
options: Acute stress is helpful in moving us towards the achievement of our goals.
Acute stress is caused by frustration, anger, rejection, distraction, distrust, and depression.
Acute stress causes the release of a damaging amount of adrenalin.
Acute stress happens to us when we feel that things are beyond our control.
CD0257 — Stress Management.answer: Acute stress is helpful in moving us towards the achievement of our goals.

options: Difficulty in making decisions, being unapproachable and ^Mquick-tempered, having many conflicts with colleagues or^Mfamily members, lack of empathy, low self-esteem
High blood pressure, pain in the chest, lack of or increased ^Mappetite, headache, dizziness, cold and sweaty hands, ^Mdifficulty in breathing

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: What is the Energy Efficiency Operational Indicator (EEOI)?
options: A measure of the energy efficiency of each voyage of a ship
An index of ships according to their energy efficiency rating
An indicator code for Port State Authorities related to the vessel’s SEEMP
An international scale used by marine equipment manufacturers to document the  energy ratings of their products
Incorrect
Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: A measure of the energy efficiency of each voyage of a ship

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: What is the Energy Efficiency Design Index?
options: An index quantifying the amount of carbon dioxide that a ship emits in relation to the goods transported
An index of ships according to their energy efficiency rating
An indicator code for auditors and inspectors related to the vessel’s International Energy Efficiency Certificate
A scale used by naval architects to predict energy criteria during the design phase of a new-building project
Incorrect
Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: An index quantifying the amount of carbon dioxide that a ship emits in relation to the goods transported

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: In respect of the energy efficiency of ships and the initiatives from within the industry to reduce carbon emissions, what do the initials MBM stand for?
options: Market-based Measures
Minimum Business Measurement
Mission-based Management
Mainframe Business Measure
Incorrect
Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: Market-based Measures

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: What is the maximum Energy Efficiency Design Index (EEDI) limit prescribed in MARPOL known as?
options: Required EEDI
Absolute EEDI
Statutory EEDI
Calculated EEDI
Incorrect
Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: Required EEDI

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: What statutory certification and examination processes will a Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP) and its associated energy management measures be subject to?
options: The applicable MARPOL annual, intermediate and 5-yearly renewal surveys
Annual flag State inspection and verification
The applicable Classification Society rules, as defined in IMO Resolution MEPC.213(63)
The relevant SOLAS bi-annual and periodic inspection surveys

Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: The applicable MARPOL annual, intermediate and 5-yearly renewal surveys

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: Which of the following describes the key role of the ship’s staff in the creation and development of a Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP)?
options: Identification of ship-specific energy efficiency measures and communication of this information back to the company office
Identification of company-specific energy efficiency measures and communication of this information to all interested parties
Investigation and documentation of energy efficiency saving results for selective reporting to the appropriate authorities
Ensuring that the IEEC renewals are promptly obtained in line with the requirements of the vessel’s SEEMP
Incorrect
Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: Identification of ship-specific energy efficiency measures and communication of this information back to the company office

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: Self-evaluation and improvement is the final step of the energy efficiency management cycle. But which one of the following best describes the last critical purpose of that step?
options: To develop the improved SEEMP for the next cycle
To complete the documentation confirming the effective implementation of the SEEMP
To obtain, or renew, the IEEC
To evaluate the cost of implementing the measures prescribed by the SEEMP
Incorrect
Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: To develop the improved SEEMP for the next cycle

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: What is the final step in the Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP) continuous improvement cycle?
options: Self-evaluation and improvement
Monitoring and recording
Accreditation

CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: Self-evaluation and improvement

Calculated EEDI

Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: Attained EEDI

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: In the simplified Energy Efficiency Design Index (EEDI) formula, which one of the following does the unit “CO₂ emission” represent?
options: Emission from combustion of fuel, including propulsion and auxiliary engines and boilers
Emission from combustion of fuel, including propulsion and auxiliary engines but excluding boilers and cargo handling machinery
Emission from combustion of fuel in the main propulsion plant only
Projected emissions calculated at the design stage of a new-building project
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: Emission from combustion of fuel, including propulsion and auxiliary engines and boilers

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: What is the significant design feature of a “twist-flow” rudder, as described in this training module, in terms of energy efficiency management?

CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: It reduces cavitation

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: As part of each Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP), the ship owner is required to do which one of the following?
options: Review current practices and energy usage onboard each ship with a view to determining any shortfalls or areas for improvement of energy efficiency
Review personal energy consumption on board and restrict usage accordingly with a view to reducing the carbon footprint of the vessel
Set targets for the reduction of environmental pollution resulting from cargo operations
Apply for an annual IEEC
Incorrect
Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: Review current practices and energy usage onboard each ship with a view to determining any shortfalls or areas for improvement of energy efficiency

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: What are the four component steps of creating and maintaining a Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP)?
options: Planning / Implementation / Monitoring / Self-evaluation and improvement
Design / Implementation / Review / Evaluation
Research / Design / Testing / Evaluation
Planning / Implementation / Monitoring / Recording
Incorrect
Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: Planning / Implementation / Monitoring / Self-evaluation and improvement

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: What does the Energy Efficiency Operational Indicator (EEOI) deliver?
options: A quantitative indicator of a ship’s or fleet’s energy efficiency
A qualitative assessment of a ship’s energy efficiency
A quantitative index against which a ship’s or fleet’s energy consumption can be measured
A numerical measure of achievement which will indicate the success of a ship in reducing its energy targets
Incorrect
Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: A quantitative indicator of a ship’s or fleet’s energy efficiency

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: Which one of the following can a Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP) form a part of?

Correct

options: By monitoring being carried out as far as possible by shore staff, utilizing data obtained from existing required records such as the official and engineering log-books and oil record books

By only utilizing data that can be electronically transferred or remotely collected in off-duty hours
By  only collecting data that does not involve any direct human activity

Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: By monitoring being carried out as far as possible by shore staff, utilizing data obtained from existing required records such as the official and engineering log-books and oil record books

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: The limits, conditions and ballast management arrangements are always to be observed when determining the optimum ballast conditions.  Where are these to be found?
options: In the ship’s Ballast Water Management Plan
In the ship’s Cargo Operations Manual
In the ship’s Safety Management Plan
Optimum ballast conditions are a matter of experience – no written guidance is available on such matters

Correct

Thermal heat from the incinerator unit

Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: Potential heat losses from the exhaust gas

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: Which one of the following does the IMO “2016 Guidelines for the Development of a Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP)” specifically recognize that many companies will already have in place?

To have ship’s crews trained to an approved standard in operational practices
To secure an International Energy management Certificate for the ship operator/owner
Incorrect
Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: To provide the framework against which a ship-owner or manager can develop a mechanism to improve the energy efficiency of a ship’s operation

By continuous incremental adjustment to the course steered to minimise water resistance
By automatic management of the engine RPM to achieve optimum speed

Correct
CD0258 — SEEMP.answer: By reducing the distance sailed "off track" and delivering better course control  and  minimising losses due to rudder resistance

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: Which one of the following is responsible for the development of a Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP)?

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: How might computer software be most effectively used by a shipping company in respect of energy efficiency management, as suggested by this module?

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: What do the letters EEDI stand for in relation to the management of ship’s energy?

Correct

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: What sort of data should be used in the self-evaluation step of a Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP) process?

The data collected over the four weeks immediately prior to the self-analysis meeting

options: Safety
Cost saving
Speed
Quality Assurance

Correct

Correct

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: As the amount of CO₂ emitted from a ship is directly related to the consumption of bunker fuel oil, what useful additional information will the Energy Efficiency Operational Indicator (EEOI) deliver to the ship’s managers / operators?

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: What is the extent of the authority of a Port State Control Officer in respect of a vessel’s energy efficiency measures?

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: The selection of the propeller is normally of course made at the design and construction stage of a ship's life and is beyond the control of the ship’s staff, but what modern design features, as quoted in this training module, could increase propulsive efficiency power and hence reduce fuel consumption?

By pumping any ballast out at the earliest possible opportunity in a cargo operation
By calculating the cost of the fuel required to pump out ballast against the freight cost of the cargo to be loaded

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: Is there a legal requirement for a ship to keep a Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP) onboard?

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: Which one of the following is an example of common modern energy saving technology that might be included in the design of a new vessel?

Low tensile steel hull plating
Biodegradable fuel filters
Two-bladed propellers

Correct

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: In respect of the development of a Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP), which one of the following statements is correct?

By deleting any reference in the charter party to charter speed
By adding a bonus clause which rewards energy efficiency
By adding a clause which penalises ships which do not practice energy efficiency management

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: Does the Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP) have to be a ‘stand-alone’ plan?

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: Which Annex of MARPOL 73/78 (as amended) contains the regulations relating to the prevention of air pollution from ships, including the requirements for a Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP)?

Annex IV
Annex VII
Annex V

Correct

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: What do the letters IEEC stand for in relation to the management of ship’s energy?

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: According to the IMO Guidelines, what should a Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP) preferably be linked to?

CD0258 — SEEMP.question: What is the legal requirement to have a Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP)?
